items.description: Pakistani PM claims Islamabad preparing for electronic signing, while Trump and Tehran trade conflicting claimsIran, the US and mediators suggested on Saturday that a preliminary peace deal could be signed within days to end the three-month war in the Middle East, though they gave differing timelines and versions of it…

items.title: IDF says over 70 Hezbollah sites hit as troops advance near south Lebanon’s Nabatieh
items.description: Lebanese army withdraws from southern city, says soldier seriously injured in Israeli drone strike; seven terror operatives killed earlier this week after emerging from tunnel The post IDF says over 70 Hezbollah sites hit as troops advance near south Lebanon’s Nabatieh appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: Trump to meet with leaders at G7 as confidence grows for Iran war deal
items.description: Pakistan says an agreement to end the Iran war is closer than ever. U.S. President Donald Trump plans to discuss demining the Strait of Hormuz at the upcoming Group of Seven summit that begins Monday.

items.title: Iran: Will a peace deal with the US be reached soon?
items.description: Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said a deal aimed at ending the war was closer than "ever before" and expected to be finalized within 24 hours. Pakistan was preparing for the electronic signing of the agreement, to be followed immediately by technical-level talks next week.

items.title: Gaza post-‘ceasefire’ deaths hit 983 as Israeli attack targets refugee camp
items.description: Israeli attack kills one person in central Gaza's Bureij camp, as a disabled Palestinian is shot in occupied West Bank.

items.title: Iran Rebuilds Missile Arsenal During US Truce, Stockpiling Fresh Russian Munitions
items.description: Iran has restored approximately 75% of its pre-war missile and drone stockpiles during its recent truce with the US. Despite massive US and Israeli air campaigns designed to permanently cripple Tehran’s offensive capacity, Tehran preserved its core hardware inside deep underground bunkers. items.title: Trump travels to France for the 52nd G7 Summit
items.description: President Trump heads to France for the G7 as the war in Iran continues to dominate global discussions.

items.title: Sudan war: UAE denies supporting RSF and Colombian recruits
items.description: Human rights organizations accuse the UAE of supporting the RSF militia, which has seen a number of high-profile defections to the Sudanese Armed Forces. Meanwhile, the civilian population continues to suffer.

items.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in airstrike, Trump says
items.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.

items.title: France's military quietly prepares for a return to Chad
items.description: A year and a half after the abrupt expulsion of French troops stationed in Chad, Paris and N'Djamena are working on resuming their bilateral military cooperation.

items.title: Russian Lawmaker Calls for Terrorist Designation for SpaceX as Company Readies Blockbuster IPO
items.description: SpaceX has provided Starlink satellite internet terminals to Ukraine since the early stages of Russia's full-scale invasion.

items.title: Iconic Artwork 'Virtually Destroyed' In Crimea Drone Strike
items.description: A massive panorama depicting a battle in the 1853-1856 Crimean War has been heavily damaged by what Russian-occupation authorities in Sevastopol say was a Ukrainian drone attack.

items.title: Hate speech spreading ‘faster than ever’, warns UN chief as global action plan is revealed
items.description: Hate speech is a grave and growing threat to peace and security, Secretary-General António Guterres warned on Thursday, calling for urgent action to break a cycle that can lead to genocide and other atrocity crimes.
